name: pipelines
text: Legacy is on the left; modern is on the right. Both use the same sample data.

name: footer
text: The sidebar footer is now one compact row, with an appearance menu, named utility links, and a collapse control.

name: pipeline-details
text: Opening a pipeline brings us into the familiar graph, with more consistent controls and spacing.

name: pipeline-spec
text: The full YAML specification remains available alongside the visual representation.

name: runs
text: In Runs, status, identity, and related resources are easier to scan.

name: filter
text: Filtering narrows the list while keeping the surrounding controls in place.

name: timeline
text: The new Timeline tab shows when components ran and how long they took. Select a task to inspect its state history, including retries and cache hits, then jump back to the graph.

name: task
text: From here, we can inspect individual tasks and their details.

name: lineage
text: The lineage view shows those relationships around the selected artifact.

name: new-run
text: New run forms group related settings into clear sections, keeping the selected pipeline and experiment visible alongside the configuration.

name: recurring
text: Recurring runs use the same form structure, with scheduling controls grouped together.

name: transfer
text: Export and import now use the shared controls too, with clear validation and a reminder that artifact files and logs stay in their original storage.

name: dark-timeline
text: Dark mode offers an alternative appearance while keeping the same layout.

name: search
text: Quick navigation puts destinations and resource search in one place.

name: closing
text: Under the hood, Base UI and Tailwind replace legacy Material UI components and overlapping styling systems. TanStack Query manages server data. Shared controls and page patterns give maintainers a consistent foundation, while keeping familiar pipeline workflows intact.
